ceviri.25: How long does a corporate site take, and what actually stretches the schedule?
ceviri.26: A corporate site is delivered in 15–30 working days. What really stretches the schedule isn't the code, it's the content: when the copy, photographs and logo files are late, every step after that slips. We've set out week by week which job happens when, in the table in the timeline section.
ceviri.27: What happens if the project runs late?
ceviri.28: When there's a delay we tell you and give you the new date in writing — we don't let it quietly drift. Because we break the schedule into stages, it stays visible which stage the delay came from and whose end it came from. We've listed the causes and the remedies point by point in the “If things go wrong” section.
ceviri.29: How is my number of revisions decided?
ceviri.30: The number of revision rounds and what each round covers is itemised in the quote; you see it before you sign. There's also 30 days of correction support after launch, and any faults that come up in that time are put right free of charge.
ceviri.31: Who prepares the copy and the photographs on the site?
ceviri.32: The copy and the photographs come from you; neither is included in the price. If you need them, we plan copywriting and photography as separate line items.
ceviri.33: Is an off-the-shelf theme or a bespoke design right for me?
ceviri.34: An off-the-shelf theme is the right call for a business on a limited budget whose only expectation of the site is to be visible online. A bespoke design makes sense for businesses that expect measurable calls, enquiries and sales from the site.  We've put a comparison table of the two approaches in the “the difference between an off-the-shelf theme and a bespoke design” section.
ceviri.35: Should I have WordPress built, or bespoke software?
ceviri.36: For most businesses publishing content and selling products, WordPress and WooCommerce are enough. Bespoke software is needed for the workflows an off-the-shelf system doesn't cover: dealer panels, booking, permissions management, processes that connect to an ERP.
ceviri.37: Should I work with an agency, or is a freelancer enough?
ceviri.38: For a one-person job a freelancer is cheaper and usually enough. An agency makes sense when design, software, advertising and content are running at the same time, and when the work has to still be standing in two years. The difference isn't talent — it's continuity and scope. When one person falls ill or moves on, the project stops; in a team of eight the work carries on and your point of contact doesn't change. Who holds the source files, the panel credentials and the documentation is also put in writing. On the other hand, for a small one-off job an agency structure just adds cost.
ceviri.39: Have you worked in our sector before?
ceviri.40: Most likely yes: as of 2026 we've completed 165 projects for 120 brands over 14 years, so the odds are good that we've worked on something close. If we haven't worked in your sector, we say so in the first meeting.  We've set out what changes from sector to sector in the “What changes by sector isn't the design” section.

ceviri.380: The thing you mustn't lose when migrating an existing site: the URLs
ceviri.381: A sentence we hear often: “we had a new site built and our traffic dropped”.
ceviri.382: The cause isn't the design: the old URLs the search engine knows have changed, and if no equivalent is defined, visitors land on an error page.
ceviri.383: The order we follow when migrating:
ceviri.384: We list every URL on the old site — pages, images and files included.
ceviri.385: We find which URLs were getting traffic and inbound links, from the measurement data.
ceviri.386: We write a new equivalent for every old URL; anything without one goes to the nearest meaningful page, not the homepage.
ceviri.387: The 301 redirects go live at the same moment as the site.
ceviri.388: The URL change is reported in Search Console and the sitemap is submitted.
ceviri.389: Error logs are watched for the first thirty days; any URL that slipped through is added the same week.
ceviri.390: There's some fluctuation in the first two or three weeks while the search engine recrawls the new structure. Don't believe anyone who tells you it won't dip at all — what can be promised is that the cause won't be a migration mistake.

_kararlar.300 Bizimle çalışmayın: 'If your budget won't stretch to a bespoke design, don't work with us.' Türkçedeki dürüst ve sert ton bilinçli korundu — sayfanın en ayırt edici cümlesi. Yumuşatmak (‘may not be the right fit’) etkisini tamamen alırdı.
_kararlar.305 Sağlık Bakanlığı: Kurum adı çevrilmedi; 'The Ministry of Health' olarak İngilizce yazıldı çünkü cümle içinde özne. Türkçe adı _muaf listesinde — 'kalan Türkçe' raporu şaşırmasın.
_kararlar.314 Hızı anlatmak yerine ölçüyoruz: 'We measure speed instead of talking about it'. Türkçedeki karşıtlık korundu; bu bölümün tamamı canlı ölçüm gösterdiği için başlığın iddiası metinle örtüşüyor.
_kararlar.319-323 canlı hız ölçümü: Cümle üç parçaya bölünmüş: 'Bu sayfa / sizin cihazınızda / ve / sizin bağlantınızda / bu sürede açıldı'. İngilizce sıra korunabildi: 'This page loaded / on your device / and / on your connection / in that time'.
_kararlar.391 şablon sayısına bakın: Sayfanın en pratik tavsiyesi. 'templates' teknik terim olarak korundu; 'layouts' daha genel olurdu ama teklif belgelerinde geçen kelime 'template'.
_kararlar.407 lisanslar kimin hesabına: 'whose account are the theme and plugin licences registered to?' — 'licence' isim hâlinde İngiliz imlası (fiil 'license'). Oxford standardı gereği.
_kararlar.429 Döviz üzerinden faturalanır: 'Invoiced in foreign currency'. İngilizce okur için 'döviz' TL dışı demek; 'in foreign currency' bunu doğru aktarıyor.
_kararlar.455 yedeği geri yükleyip açılıyor mu: 'we periodically restore the backup for real, to check it actually opens' — 'for real' vurgusu Türkçedeki 'gerçekten' karşılığı ve bu maddenin bütün anlamı orada.
_kararlar.494-499 görsel alt metinleri: SEO odaklı yazılmış alt metinler; İngilizcede de aynı anahtar ifadeler (Core Web Vitals, 301 redirect, corporate website delivery timeline) korunarak yazıldı.
